item.title: Gas explosion in New Hampshire sparks a fire at a mental health facility
item.description: Three firefighters were injured when a natural gas leak caused an explosion and fire Monday at a New Hampshire mental health center, but the building's occupants all evacuated safely.

item.title: Snowbanks create challenges for first responders
item.description: Whether its a house fire or a medical emergency, the massive snowbanks left behind by last week's significant winter storm have been difficult for first responders to navigate.

item.title: Patriots Championship Chase: Updates all week from Santa Clara
item.description: 12 Sports Director Sam Knox and 12 News anchor Kait Walsh are in Santa Clara, California, and will have reports each day on air and online.

item.title: 'Gravy' the famous Middletown turkey rescued after getting hit by car
item.description: A turkey named Gravy that gained notoriety for holding up traffic in Middletown is now recovering in Glocester after he was hit by a vehicle.

item.title: 'Smoking materials' suspected cause of Providence fire that hurt 5, displaced 11
item.description: A total of 11 people were forced from their home and multiple were injured after a fire broke out in Providence early Sunday morning.

item.title: Coast Guard identifies victims and begins investigating fishing boat's sinking that killed 7
item.description: U.S. Coast Guard officials said Monday they have identified all seven victims who perished when a commercial fishing vessel sank in the frigid waters off Gloucester, Massachusetts, with no mayday call.

item.title: Cash clash: Foulkes outraises McKee as primary rematch looms
item.description: Gov. Dan McKee and challenger Helena Foulkes are heading for a rematch at the Democratic primary election in September.
